svg.aria-label: Charles Dickens is 0 of 20: going by punctuation alone, none of his 20 books is matched to him. Each book flies from his shelf to the author it was taken for: Robert E. Howard 7, Alexandre Dumas 3, Fyodor Dostoyevsky 2, and one each to Jules Verne, Robert Louis Stevenson, Homer, Edgar Allan Poe, Jacob Grimm, Leo Tolstoy, John Milton and Bertrand Russell.
svg.text: DICKENS: 0 OF 20, AND 7 WENT TO ROBERT E. HOWARD
Going by punctuation alone, who each of his 20 books was taken for
